flow_runs.note: One row per traceable business process run (e.g. one lot number). Created from the anchor step; other steps attach via flow_key_aliases.

columns.name: upload_batch_id
columns.note: The import_job that created this flow_run

columns.name: flow_key
columns.note: Primary key value from the anchor step (e.g. lot_no)

columns.name: flow_key_type
columns.note: Column name that provided flow_key (e.g. 批號)

columns.name: process_date
columns.note: Canonical process date detected from anchor step date column; used for display/filtering only, not for matching

flow_key_aliases.note: All known key values for a flow_run across different steps. Solves the cross-table key format mismatch problem.

columns.name: key_type
columns.note: Column name (e.g. 原料卡號, 生產批號)

columns.name: key_value
columns.note: The actual key value in that step

columns.name: confirmed_by
columns.note: auto | user_id — auto means system inferred; user_id means manually confirmed

trace_chains.note: Identity and aggregate status of one traceable data chain. Step-level detail is in trace_chain_steps.

columns.name: chain_hash
columns.note: SHA256 of all completed step_hashes sorted by step_order; recomputed on each step update

trace_chain_steps.note: One row per step per trace chain. Dynamic — adding a new step type requires no schema change.

columns.name: step_order
columns.note: Sort order within the chain; used when computing chain_hash

columns.name: step_hash
columns.note: SHA256 of all row_hashes for this step; NULL if not yet uploaded

records.note: stub generated by assemble-system.ps1; exact columns are domain-specific
